name: nginx-multisite
description: Configures Nginx as a reverse proxy and web host for three SSL-enabled sites, including static content, firewall rules, SSH hardening, fail2ban, sysctl settings, and development certificates.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service management, and a workaround for generated replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI application with Python tooling, Git checkout, virtual environment, PostgreSQL database and user setup, environment configuration, and a systemd-managed Uvicorn service.
